decision: Compare execution context, then replace the streaming DFT with a preallocated FFT while preserving the model.
reason: The original native frontend uses quadratic transforms. The first phone deadline failure also includes off-CPU time, so native compute and scheduling must be assessed separately.

invariants.backend: Gnani Prisma plus OpenAI GPT-6 Luna

comparisons: Original APK: shell app_process versus managed Android instrumentation.
Managed instrumentation: original DFT versus rebuilt FFT, same model and input hashes.
Qualified native output: clean/raw, clean/enhanced, colored-noise/raw, colored-noise/enhanced through equal backend settings.
numerical_checks: Forward and inverse transforms against the original implementation.
Zeros, impulses, DC, Nyquist, sinusoidal and deterministic random inputs.
Window, normalization, overlap, stream state and PCM-output comparison.
interpretation: A processing-gate pass is not a zero-delay, ASR-quality, battery-life or all-phone guarantee. Report initialization, fixed alignment, scheduling and recognition separately.
